name: youtube-misinformation-detector
description: Manifest V3 Chrome Extension detecting real-time misinformation on YouTube videos with interactive timeline drawer

scripts.pack: npm run build && mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/youtube-misinformation-detector.zip && zip -r dist/youtube-misinformation-detector.zip manifest.json src/ popup/ icons/ -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.test:all: npm test && node tests/e2e.test.js && node tests/e2e-realworld.test.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:unit
